scripts.build: npm run version:sync && tsc && vite build
scripts.tauri:build:windows: npm run version:sync:release && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.tauri:build:windows:portable: npm run version:sync && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --no-bundle
scripts.tauri:build:macos-dmg: npm run version:sync && tauri build --bundles app,dmg --no-sign && sh -c 'for f in src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg; do [ -e "$f" ] || exit 0; mv -f "$f" src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/; done'
